# Data contract — isolated D fixture v1 (not C Public DTO)
Top-level datasetVersion competition-ai4-demo/1.0; synthetic=true; purpose SYNTHETIC_DEMO_NOT_CUSTOMER_SPEC.
requests: 15 records. id=requestId; reportId/testItemId unique; testItemId is a CASE TEST INSTANCE identifier, not a new catalog definition. testItems contains EXACTLY one existing catalog label. catalogType binds requestTestCatalog.mjs hash. testVariant describes a synthetic method under that existing type.
requests.quantity/sampleIds: 3 samples/case. sampleEnvelope has body/fixture descriptive L values plus declared synthetic measured enclosing envelope sampleVolumeLitres=0.125. This is synthetic occupied-envelope data, not a general geometry summation/profile. Space Unit unused and never converted. Equipment usableVolumeLitres=8 is L; capacity=12 is sample count; requiredDevices=1 is device count. No physical placement/calibration/customer authority claim.
requests.conditions: temperature_min/max Celsius; humidity_min/max percentRH. method fields use explicit names/units (temperatureC, humidityRH, exposureHours, lowC/highC, dwellMinutes, transferMinutes, cycles, frequencyMinHz/MaxHz, accelerationG, hoursPerAxis, peakG, pulseMs, nozzleMm/flowLMin/distanceM/sprayMinutes, solutionPercent, pH, contactKV/airKV, supplyV/standbyMinutes). Individual Demo methods are defined per profile in build_dataset.py. All numeric method/acceptance settings are DEMO, not official ES/client/IP/ESD conformance.
startDate/endDate ISO date-only; duration_days is explicitly authored integer, no hours-to-day or partial-day conversion. Engine inclusive end-date rule preserved. Each trial starts independently. Raw timestamps ISO8601 +08:00; method dwell/axis duration does not redefine DAY scheduling.
testResults.rawMeasurements: sampleId, BEFORE/AFTER, measurementId, metric, value DECIMAL STRING, unit, recordedAt, applicable cycleCount, source SYNTHETIC. No empty value -> zero conversion. Rules CLOSED_INTERVAL lower<=value<=upper with matching units. measurementDecisions, perSampleResults and overallResult all recomputable. Appearance defect count is independent from the type-specific functional metric. Three samples have both pre/post functional + appearance rows.
rawFileBytesSha256 is SHA256 of the exact generated data/raw/...json FILE BYTES. nativeMeasurementsDigest is existing Core canonical JSON digest of the mapped numeric measurement list. Neither is a real-world issuer signature. Dataset values used for Core are integers/exact dyadic numbers; raw decimal strings retained unchanged.
reportDrafts: DRAFT_ONLY, PENDING_HUMAN, signatures=[], reportId/requestId/testItemId, pageCount2..5, ordered sectionIds, computed overallResult, anomalies, engineResultCaseId/coreDraftData/coreOutputDigest (ACTUAL E3 Core draft output). No forged Excel/signedExcel/pdf/reportWorkflow stage.
reportSections: nonempty semantic page groups, not rendered pages. Basic/method/SETUP-DURING_TEST references/results/one-source charts/anomalies/prepost/traceability and human-review content. Two-page cases merge sections rather than add blank pages. A must validate actual overflow/page breaks/fonts before declaring 2..5 rendered pages.
photoReferences: 30 requirements, unique assetId, request/report/test links, phase SETUP or DURING_TEST, purposes/captions. PENDING_CREATION, filePath=null. No image files synthesized/copied; A must create authorized synthetic assets and bind IDs, never silently substitute real/stock/client files.
engineInputs/engineExpectedResults: 70 independent expected cases, 60 linked positives (15x4) +10 negatives/deviation/conflicts. engineExecutionEvidence has actual Core output, audit hashes, rule-only disposition, publicResult=null. E4 query is explicit synthetic source heading/phrase; lexical excerpt return, not natural-language reasoning/RAG/LLM. Missing source/version conflict refuse; no fabricated clauses.
sourceProvenance: per-case synthetic spec ID/version/locator/digest, raw-file hash, native measurement digest profile and synthetic capacity source trust. specRef is NOT an official standard. No real accounts/signatures/certificates/customer documents.
